common_prompt: Original instrumental ambient chamber documentary underscore for a long mathematical explainer with continuous spoken narration. Modern clean studio production, warm felt piano and very soft sustained pads, delicate light strings. Sparse notes, low note density, restrained dynamics, leave space for the voice. D major or its relative B minor, approximately 64 BPM with no drums or percussion. No vocals, humming, choir, speech, sound effects, dramatic hits, drops, crescendos, busy arpeggios or prominent lead melody. Gently evolving harmony, soft transients, transparent midrange, no sub bass. Maintain an even quiet texture throughout, suitable for a long crossfaded loop without an obvious ending.

chapters.name: curiosity
chapters.mood: Quiet curiosity and open possibility; a few widely spaced warm piano notes above an airy pad. A welcoming, thoughtful opening, without suspense or drama.

chapters.name: colouring_game

chapters.name: geometry

chapters.name: history

chapters.name: abstraction
chapters.mood: Spacious contemplative abstraction, exploring why a problem is difficult. Very sparse piano and soft suspended pad harmonies, thoughtful and slightly mysterious without becoming ominous.

chapters.name: proof
chapters.mood: Steady quiet concentration for a sustained rigorous mathematical proof. Extremely sparse felt piano, soft warm strings and pads, patient harmonic progression, understated forward motion, no dramatic resolution or build-up.

chapters.name: ai_context
chapters.mood: Sober measured reflection about artificial intelligence and uncertainty. Nearly weightless warm pads, occasional low soft piano notes, grounded and serious, calm, no futuristic noises or technological effects.

chapters.name: verification
chapters.mood: Clear careful concentration while discussing evidence and mathematical verification. Very restrained felt piano and thin sustained string harmonics, calm intellectual precision and humility, sober and spacious.

chapters.name: resolution
chapters.mood: Gentle understated resolution and thoughtful optimism, for concluding a mathematical documentary and its sources card. Warm piano and a soft luminous pad, open major harmony, reflective rather than triumphant, no final flourish.
